title: Magnolia Terrace — Investment & Sales Offering Memorandum (Revised)
subtitle: Raleigh, NC multifamily • As-of 2026-09-01 • Original fictional evaluation material

sections.heading: Revision Summary
paragraphs: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

This revision applies revision-notice.pdf (2026-09-01) and rent-roll-revised.xlsx. Suite 045 is now active with scheduled rent raised by $225 to $2,150. The cap rate increases by 25 bps to 6.00% and the initial sizing rate increases by 75 bps to 7.00%. All other underwriting rules, expenses, insurance, T-12, Suite 001 amendment and payoff are unchanged.

sections.heading: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Magnolia Terrace is a 48-unit multifamily asset in Raleigh, NC. Under the revised inputs, UW NOI before reserves is $643,862 on $945,045 of EGI, producing $10,731,028 of capitalization value at 6.00%. Underwritten NCF is $629,462. Debt sizing at 7.00% over 30-year amortization is DSCR-binding at $6,307,523 (LTV cap $6,975,168, DY cap $6,994,018). After 1% origination, $45,000 closing costs and $4,200,000 payoff, net cash-out is $1,999,448 (still positive; refinance shortfall absent).
Physical occupancy on the revised roll is 45 of 48 units (93.75% by unit; 39,770/40,800 = 97.48% by area). The prior pending-in-occupancy risk is resolved because Suite 045 is now active.

sections.heading: Lease & Occupancy Analysis
paragraphs: The revised certified rent roll dated 2026-09-01 supersedes the 2026-08-31 certified roll and the 2026-06-30 archive. Annual in-place rent updates to (1x1,850 + 14x1,500 + 15x1,650 + 14x1,925 + 1x2,150) x 12 = $920,400.

paragraphs: Sizing rate 7.00% is the greater of the revised initial sizing rate (6.25% + 75 bps = 7.00%) and the 6.00% floor. DSCR is the binding constraint at $6,307,523.

sections.heading: Risks & Missing Diligence
paragraphs: Pending-in-occupancy: ABSENT (previously PRESENT). Suite 045 is now active on the revised roll; the manager mapping issue no longer applies.
Near-term rollover: ABSENT. All leases expire 2029-08-31.
Missing insurance: ABSENT. GL aggregate $2,000,000 policy in force through 2027-06-30.
Capital in opex: ABSENT. Roof classified as capital in the T-12.

Temporary free rent: ABSENT. Lease-001 states no free-rent concession.
Sizing-floor binding: ABSENT. Revised sizing rate 7.00% exceeds floor 6.00%.
Refinance shortfall: ABSENT. Max loan $6,307,523 exceeds $4,200,000 payoff plus fees; positive net cash-out.

Missing diligence: legal, environmental, property condition and title reviews remain pending (routine, no defects asserted). Photos, asking price, market comps and sponsor history remain not supplied and are not invented.
